# Sprout & Smile Family Dentistry

> Gentle, Caring Dentistry for Every Generation in Your Family. Located in Indiranagar, Bangalore.

## Overview
Sprout & Smile Family Dentistry (Aura Dental Sanctuary) is a premier dental practice in Indiranagar, Bangalore, specializing in pediatric dental care, painless single-visit micro root canals, clear aligners (Invisalign®), biocompatible dental implants for seniors, ultrasonic teeth cleaning, and 24/7 same-day emergency relief.

## Key Facts
- **Location**: #412, 2nd Floor, 100 Feet Road, Near CMH Junction, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India
- **Phone**: +91 (080) 4921-0088 / WhatsApp: +91 98765 43210
- **Email**: care@sproutsmile.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 8:30 PM | Saturday & Sunday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM (Full Team Active 7 days a week)
- **Clinical Director**: Dr. Ananya Sharma, MDS (Pedodontics Gold Medalist, 14+ years experience)
- **Specialists**: Dr. Karthik Rao, MDS (Orthodontics & Clear Aligners), Dr. Shalini Menon, MDS (Prosthodontics & Senior Implants)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015 Medical Care, Class-B Autoclave Sterilization, Zero-Tears Pediatric Guarantee
